Net neutrality classifies the internet as a utility, which means for the most part that you pay the same price for the internet, even if you use more internet. The internet can only carry so much information at once due to limited bandwith - sort of like how a highway can only hold so many cars.

Without net neutrality, people who use more internet would have to pay more than people who don't. With net neutrality, everyone pays the same no matter how much they use.
